Welcome to 3 Rivers and Rosalie Forest Eco Lodge, Dominica
A multi award winning, remote, off grid, Eco lodge, Retreat / event Venue,  Zipline adventure, & sustainable living education centre; set in a lush rainforest valley surrounded by fresh flowing rivers, natural river pools, nature trails and rainforest mountains, in natural and unspoiled eastern Dominica.
We offer a unique nature, secluded & Eco adventure getaway experience, in an extremely remote location, respecting our surroundings, together with our community.
A wide range of Eco friendly, unique, and charming ACCOMMODATIONS, (private cottages & apartments, shared dormitory hostel & camping facilities),    bar, self-catering options, and a small on site grocery store, together with a range of nature, community, and adventure, ACTIVITIES for everyone. .or simply relax and enjoy our Three Rivers and natural river pools.
As well as our on site self-catering options, there are a handful of local restaurants, as well as a small on-site  grocery store, and and a few local small grocery stores
The perfect place for tranquil YOU time or group retreats; artists, writers, yoga, meditation, and simply an amazing closeness to nature.
We also have our very own on site ziplining across our natural river pools, and offer daycations day passes which also include a snack and a juice. CLICK HERE FOR DAYCATION DETAILS.
Ideal for individuals, couples, retreats, families and friends, We also specialise in groups for wildlife / nature research, community and environmental study programmes, or just book our picturesque & remote property for your own group needs. restaurant catering is available for groups –  Contact us for more details

About Us
WELCOME TO
OUR ECOLODGE
Hi, my name is Jem Winston, born & raised in south east England. I am the dreamer, founder & managing director of 3 Rivers & Rosalie Forest Eco Lodge, and I welcome you to Dominica.
I first discovered Dominica in 1990, during my years of backpacking, in my early 20’s, and fell in love with the place instantly. That love has never faded, and I am proud now to also be a Dominican.
Click here to read my full story and the history of the ecolodge
MEET THE REST OF THE TEAM
My name is Lincoln Thomas and I am originally from the nearby village of Petite Soufriere, one of the most unspoiled villages on the island, and now live with my family in Grand Fond, close to 3 Rivers
I have been at the lodge for more than 15 years, and am the building and maintenace manager.
I am Pearl Samuel , from Grand Fond. As well as being the housekeeping manager, I also deal with reservations and help out in the kitchen and garden when I have spare time.
Hey, my name is Kenny Francis, the man about the place who aims to help you with everything and anything, and I look forward to helping you out and being your tour guide

Getting to 3 rivers
GETTING TO 3 RIVERS ECO LODGE
3 Rivers & Rosalie Forest Eco Lodge is situated a mile or so inland from Rosalie, on the east coast of Dominica. Reach us by taxi, car rental, buses, walking, or hitchhiking
Whether you arrive at one of the airports, or at the ferry terminal, the easiest way to reach us is by booking our airport/ferry collection service, allowing you to just relax and enjoy the stunning scenery, and let us tell you a bit about our island. CLICK HERE BOOK OUR TRANSFER SERVICES .
Alternatively, there are always plenty of taxis. Roseau ferry terminal (45 minutes drive) Expect to pay around EC$190 / US$75, and Douglas-Charles/Melville Hall airport (DOM) (1 hour and 15 minutes drive) EC$220 / US$85.
If you arrive before 4 pm, there are buses and hitchhiking works well enough. After that taxi is probably the best way if you do not have a vehicle
Book here your transportation to our lodge!
If you decide to rent a vehicle, or hire a taxi, you need a vehicle with high clearance for our access road, a low car may touch the road, and some taxis will leave you 5 minutes extra walk away on the main road; check before you ride.
IF YOU TAKE A TAXI, AND IF THEY LEAVE YOU AT THE MAIN ROAD, WE MAY NOT HAVE A VEHICLE TO COLLECT YOU !!!!!
DIRECTIONS
From Douglas Charles (formerly known as Melville Hall) airport, (DOM) follow the airport exit signs past the car park to the main exit barrier.
Turn right over the bridge as you leave the airport barrier and follow the road through and past the town of Marigot and stay on the main road until the main road crosses a bridge, bends right only, and moves away from the coast.
As you leave the coasT, you will drive straight past, almost immediately on your left, a road that goes towards the Kalinago territory, GO STRAIGHT PAST THE TURNING and up the mountain road, DO NOT turn left.
Stay on this long windy road for about 20 minutes to half an hour, until you reach a roundabout, called pond casse, with a bus shelter and a heritage sign in the middle.
Turn left towards Rosalie, Emerald pool and Castle Bruce.
See below FINAL APPROACH INSTRUCTIONS
From Roseau head north out of the city over the independence street bridge and follow the main road north, direction Canefield, Mahault, Salisbury and portsmouth.
Follow the road heading out of town, passing the cargo port on your left, and driving under a big cliff alongside the Ocean as far as Canefield, go past the Nissan showroom on the right, and past R&C tyre repairs on the left. You will see the National Bank of Dominica on your right. Then turn right immediately after National Bank of Dominica, onto a very short road. then left at the end of the very short road and go over the mountains for about 20 minutes until you reach the only roundabout, named Pont Cassé. Turn right.
See below FINAL APPROACH INSTRUCTIONS
From Canefield airport , turn right onto the main highway, then left at the mini roundabout. At the top, turn left and follow the road up the mountain until you reach the only roundabout, named Pont Cassé. Turn right.
SKIP TO SEE BELOW FINAL APPROACH DIRECTIONS.
PUBLIC TRANSPORT
There are NO BUSES ON SUNDAYS AND PUBLIC HOLIDAYS. AND NONE AFTER 1PM ON SATURDAYS
If you want to use public bus, from Roseau, (Last bus leaves at 5pm) The buses for our lodge leave from Kennedy Avenue, either side of the junction with Independence street, near to Jays Bookstore and Burton electrical shop, and take the bus which goes to Grand Fond, Riviere Cyrique, La Plaine or Delices.
Tell the driver you are coming to 3 rivers eco lodge and they will drop you at the main road from where you will walk in down the road and across a small ravine.
See below final approach directions.
From the Melville Hall airport, take any bus towards Roseau and change at the Pond Casse roundabout junction. You want to turn left, towards the Emerald pool, Castle Bruce and Rosalie,
Wait at the bus stop for a bus that is coming in our direction, Tell the driver you are coming to 3 rivers eco lodge in Rosalie and they will drop you at the main road by our signpost and access road.
See below FINAL APPROACH INSTRUCTIONS.
FINAL APPROACH DIRECTIONS
From Pond Cassé roundabout follow the road straight down, direction Emerald pool, Castle Bruce and Rosalie, for about 20 minutes, passing 2 bars on the left hand side, and driving straight past the turning on the left signposted to The Emerald pool and Kalinago Carib territory.
Do not turn left, go straight.
Carry on straight down the windy road for about 10 minutes, eventually you will go down a very steep bendy hill, and at the bottom of the hill on the bend you will see a sign on the right saying ‘3 Rivers Eco Lodge ’. If you reach the Ocean you’ve gone a few minutes too far; turn round and come back up the hill!!!
Turn right down the dirt road.
Then, follow the dirt road for 5 minutes, GO SLOW ITS BUMPY. you will drive through a small ravine and then you will arrive at our neighbour’s big concrete farmhouse.
This is where you park your vehicle and begin your three rivers adventure.
A basic level of fitness is required.
BACKPACKS not suitcases are the best way to manage your luggage across the rivers. PLEASE BRING BACKPACKS NOT SUITCASES IF POSSIBLE.
ACCESS To the lodge is the first part of your adventure.
A basic level of fitness is required. It is necessary to zip line across or walk through two rivers, with a rope to guide you across and a pulley for your bags, making it fun, adventurous, and not too difficult.
As well as a short 5 to 10 minute walk through the neighbouring farm between the two river crossings.
Follow this link to see a video showing the access to the lodge.
